review.official:
Croissant, a member of
Penguin Logistics
, is a proficient
defender
who is able to hold back several enemies at once. She also possesses monstrous strength, able to send lesser enemies flying with her massive hammer.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this Operator is believed to be non-infected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
Operator Croissant showed no symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L 
Operator Croissant sometimes delivers packages or sells goods with Originium content, but it has not caused infection to date.

An energetic messenger. 
She believes that the purpose of work is to improve one's quality of life, and that shopping is the best way to improve her life. 
She isn't hung up on money, but she does enjoy living paycheck-to-paycheck while jumping on opportunities to make a quick profit. She can often be seen hawking goods in various places.

Messengers usually get two kinds of work: Delivering mail and messages, or transporting cargo. 
The former requires speed; the latter, strength and endurance. In Penguin Logistics, Croissant was an obvious stand-out in the latter. 
Also notable, Croissant is extraordinarily strong even for a Forte. Swinging a hefty hammer in one hand while carrying a heavy shield in the other is as simple as breathing to her.

While not a big operation, Penguin Logistics is well-connected at all levels in Lungmen. 
Thus, taking advantage of the channels back home, Croissant's irregular hawking ventures could be a treasure trove that just might offer rarities you wouldn't find anywhere else. 
Of course, don't let Croissant know if you did spot a valuable item, or she will wring your wallet.

Even as an Operator, Croissant has no plans to give up her hobbies and interests. 
She knows an Operator will face unprecedented danger and see many unfortunate events. Nevertheless, she is still a city girl who counts her pennies. 
Maybe Rhodes Island recruits civilian Operators because they're not jaded and thus fearless, but it's definitely not because they should be exposed to the cruelty of the real world. It's more like the island have many unfortunate people who needed someone as adorable as Croissant to show them what a normal, blissful life is like. 
Of course, the unfortunate or hateful may begrudge the blessed, but at least it never happens at Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: This here Croissant guarantees yer safety, no matter where yer headin', Baws! Oh, 'n payment's upfront! 'Member that!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Make a buncha money workin' yer butt off! We can't be livin' in no poverty, after all!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Yer kiddin'! All yer people got such shiny gear on 'em! Lemme have a touch too!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Boy, I sure love orderin' new gear! Feels like I bought enough stuff to fill the whole depot! This what they call a 'shoppin' addiction'?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Every month there's more 'n more bills to pay... 'n that's why I sell some stuff I find on the side! Everythin' I got is cheap 'n high quality!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Move this, lift that. If we gotta be haulin' things, might as well pick some easy-to-use and yummy-yummy stuff!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Baws, Baws! Found this here heckin' tasty thing lyin' around, ya want a bite? Ya ask me, the only thing second to gud gear is gud food!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Baws, c'mere a sec, wouldja? Take a gander at my wares! From fancy clothes 'n everyday items to office supplies and gear, ya name it, I got it! Buy in bulk 'n I'll give ya a discount!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Baws, I gotta thank ya! With all them referrals, I can buy everything I ever wanted! Yer the best, Baws! Love ya lots!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Aw shucks, gotta tighten my belt again this month...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: The name's Croissant, and by golly yer in luck, Baws! Won't find nobody as good at their trade as I am! I'm strong, don't break easy, 'n if ya hire me right now, I'll give ya a 20% discount!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I reckon I'll get more work if I get stronger!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank ya kindly, Baws, fer helpin' me find such a nice job.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Baws, Baws, I made good use of that there bonus ya gave me! Check it out, I don’t got myself some new gear. All the better to keep ya safe!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Leave the defense to me!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Listen up, y'all! Let's do this here mission nice and cleanlike!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: We'll be back with the best results ya ever did see!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Well lookee here. The bad guys're comin' to donate their gear!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What can I do ya for?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Time to try this here new gear!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: H'all righty!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Here we are!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: End of the road!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Ya ain't gettin' through me!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: THUNDERCLAP!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: That ain't gon' work on me!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Ya reckon the enemy dropped a treasure chest or somesuch?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Yeehaw! Mission accomplished!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Dagnabbit... the enemy got away! That ain't good for my rep…

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Aw, shucks… First I lost the fight, and now my wallet…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Ya got any treasure chests hidin' 'round here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Baws, Baws, got any nifty stuff on hand? C'mon, I wanna see!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Baws! The Penguin Logistics girls're countin' on yer business. And my hammer and shield'll keep yer goodies safe wherever they need to go. Hehe, if'n ya trust me enough, feel free to cut out Emperor and send the job straight to me!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Howdy, Baws!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Shhh! Rise n' shine, Baws. Get'cher clothes on! We gotta move before the others wake up. Texas's got the engine runnin', and Exusiai's talkin' about a champaign buffet with all the rubber bullets we'n shoot. Relax, Baws, we know a thing or two about birthday parties.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Even yer most carefully-laid plan ain't gonna carry you outta the swamp when yer all stuck in it. That's when ya come lookin' fer the unstoppable force! Hold the shiny equipment! That's the reason Rhodes Island n' Penguin Logistics're like two peas in a pod! Here's to keepin' that unstoppable force rollin', Baws!
